subject: Document coordination conflict on the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the

messages.text: Shop drawings for the Section 08 44 13 curtain wall mullion detail at the building corner are ready to submit, but what's shown doesn't match what's built out in the field mockup -- can you confirm which governs? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. This could affect the contract sum depending on the resolution. No schedule impact is expected. A response within three days would be appreciated.
